item.title: Louisiana group back home after being trapped in Israel bomb shelter
item.description: Louisiana State Chaplain Michael Sprague and 43 others spent six days visiting biblical sites, as part of a 13-day pilgrimage through the Holy Land. But upon arriving in Jerusalem, he said the peace immediately disappeared.

item.title: Family remembers man fatally struck by truck, calls for improved safety measures
item.description: On the night of Sunday, March 1, Chad Williams was hit by a car on Jean Lafitte Boulevard in Jefferson Parish. He died two days later in the hospital, leaving behind a wife, a teenage son, and many loved ones.
